question: Can the existing frozen Polymarket data and its published analysis samples be reconciled to preserved source records without unexplained loss, duplication, contradictory outcomes or mislabeled economic actions?
scope: Existing historical canon and its separate legacy-expanded and native-action sports lineages. Kalshi is excluded. This audit does not refresh date coverage or replace existing data.

observational_units.legacy_published_view: Maker row plus inferred opposite-action counterparty row; not certified own-wallet actions.
observational_units.native_own_order: One verified own-wallet OrderFilled action, with aggregate execution/refund reconciliation.
observational_units.native_matched_execution: Actual recovered matching leg; NORMAL has one BUY, MINT two complementary BUYs, MERGE no BUY.

phase_1.published_integrity: Inventory and schema checks, then serial monthly scalar scans for required fields, units, UTC partition consistency, token/outcome coverage, and count/cash reconciliation.
phase_1.native_lineage: Complete deterministic timestamp windows, expanded to all relevant blocks and boundary seconds, with source identities retained through the canonical transformation.
phase_1.native_classification: Separate identical native replays, conflicting payloads at one identity, exchange-facing aggregates, nonaggregate logs sharing transaction/order, mapping failures, unresolved markets and value-equal records with different identities.
phase_1.inference: A bounded window certifies that window only. Repeated order hashes do not, by themselves, establish distinct economic executions. Matching metadata does not establish final artifact membership.

initial_resource_contract.publication: New immutable run directories and atomic scalar checkpoints only. No large exports.

acceptance_gates: Every required input has an explicit schema, grain, frozen identity and inventory.
No null or conflicting native identity is admitted as certified; exact replays and conflicts are separate.
All records in an audited window receive a mutually reconcilable inclusion or exclusion status.
Published token joins have zero unmatched, duplicate-key fanout or contradictory outcome rows.
Exact timestamps are validated by required-key coverage, not total-row equality.
Source-to-published counts and cash reconcile at the stated observation unit.
Economic-direction assertions require own-order or full native-batch evidence.
Incomplete or failed stages remain visibly incomplete; certification is never inferred from a normal exit alone.
not_authorized_by_this_contract: Changing the economic observation grain of existing analyses
Updating outcomes or collecting new market/block data
Expanding storage or deleting existing artifacts
Publishing revised scientific results before reconciliation
later_required_for_full_certification: Exhaustive bounded-window native identity and exclusion reconciliation across the declared history
Independent collection-completeness evidence for block ranges and every relevant emitting exchange
Full sports membership/filter waterfall and reopened native recovery proofs
Documented treatment of unresolved markets, ambiguous records and provider-clock limitations
Reviewed versioned corrections and downstream result comparisons if measured defects warrant rebuilding
infrastructure_owner: root only; finish transfers, confirm every agent/process is idle, stop EC2, and verify stopped after this task
